_README: Companies that have asked not to be contacted again. Nothing in this repo
may write to them - not an application, not a follow-up, not a speculative
note, not a reply. Enforced in send_email(), which every outgoing message
goes through, so a new stage cannot forget to check.
Match on any of: 'name' (loosely, against the company name on a listing),
A domain is the strongest entry - it covers addresses nobody has seen yet.
Add an entry the day somebody asks. Removing one needs them to say so.
